# `Q-5-33` — Format not supported by book projects

> Book projects render only to formats with book support.

## What this means

A book project is not a bag of independent documents: chapters are
numbered as one sequence, cross-references resolve across chapters,
and single-file formats merge every chapter into one continuous
document. Only formats that implement that machinery can render a
book. In this version of Quarto those are:

- **`html`** — each chapter renders as its own page (multi-file).
- **`typst`** — chapters merge into a single compiled PDF.
- **`epub`** — chapters merge into a single e-book.

The format you asked for is not one of these, so the render is
rejected rather than silently producing disconnected per-chapter
files with no book structure.

## Why this happens

- **`--to docx` or `--to pptx` on a book.** Quarto 1 produced one
  disconnected file per chapter for these formats — no shared
  numbering, no cross-chapter references — which Quarto 2 treats as
  "not a book format" rather than reproducing.
- **A format listed under `format:` in the book's `_quarto.yml`**
  that has no book support.

## How to fix

Render to a supported format:

```bash
q2 render my-book --to html
q2 render my-book --to typst
q2 render my-book --to epub
```

If you need the chapters as standalone DOCX files, render the
individual chapter documents directly rather than the book project.
